name: epsilon
description: An epsilon app — one op stream, Postgres to pixel.

scripts.test: bun test epsilon/op.test.ts epsilon/signal.test.ts epsilon/doc.test.ts epsilon/ui.test.ts epsilon/route.test.ts epsilon/cli.test.ts epsilon/law.test.ts epsilon/upgrade.test.ts
scripts.test:pg: bun test epsilon/pg.test.ts epsilon/rel.test.ts epsilon/view.test.ts epsilon/passkey.test.ts
scripts.ci: bun run db:up && bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:migrate && bun run test:pglite && bun run test:pg && bun run test:app; code=$?; bun run db:down; exit $code
